# Narra Suryakoushik Reddy (NSKR)

> AI Automation Engineer based in India, building agentic automation systems
> with n8n, LangChain and Python. Currently AI Automations Engineer at Valari
> Solutions. Open-source contributor, and open to projects.

Reddy turns manual workflows into agentic systems — the kind that run while
teams sleep. Work sits at the intersection of LLMs, automation and real-world
infrastructure, with current focus on RAG pipelines and MCP tools.

Contact is by email at red@nskr.dev.

The site is a single page rendered client-side with React, so this file and
`/llms-full.txt` carry the full text content for agents and crawlers that do
not execute JavaScript.

## Work

- [Experience](https://nskr.in/#experience): AI Automations Engineer at Valari Solutions (Dec 2025–present, promoted from Junior in Feb 2026); AI Agent Innovations Intern at Skin Seoul (Jul–Sep 2025); NSS volunteer at Lovely Professional University.
- [Featured projects](https://nskr.in/#featured): LLM Council, Dance Move Insight, ARISE.
- [More projects](https://nskr.in/#projects): Deep Facial Verification, Autonomous Disaster Response Agent, Omarchy, nskr.me, an n8n workflow automation suite, and a RAG playground.

## Skills

- [Stack](https://nskr.in/#skills): AI/ML (PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, MCP, Ollama, AWS Bedrock), automation (n8n, Python, REST APIs), languages (Python, TypeScript, Go, C++), backend (FastAPI, Flask, Node.js), infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Linux) and databases (PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB).

## Background

- [Education and certifications](https://nskr.in/#education): MCA specialising in AI & ML at Lovely Professional University; data science at JNTU Hyderabad; BSc Computer Science at Visakha Defence Academy. Certified through HarvardX, Microsoft and CompTIA.
- [Writing](https://nskr.in/#writing): posts on self-hosting n8n and on building production e-commerce automation.
